+# Same syntax as the Launchpad changelog bug-closing convention.
+LP_BUG_RE = re.compile(r"lp:\s+#\d+(?:,\s*#\d+)*", re.IGNORECASE)
+
+
+def bugs_from_comment(comment):
+    bugs = []
+    for match in LP_BUG_RE.finditer(comment or ""):
+        for num in re.findall(r"\d+", match.group(0)):
+            if int(num) not in bugs:
+                bugs.append(int(num))
+    return bugs
+

+def close_bugs(options, bugs, packages, message):
+    ubuntu = options.launchpad.distributions["ubuntu"]
+    target_links = {ubuntu.self_link}
+    target_links.update(
+        "%s/+source/%s" % (ubuntu.self_link, name) for name in packages)
+    for bug_num in bugs:
+        try:
+            bug = options.launchpad.bugs[bug_num]
+        except KeyError:
+            print("Cannot find LP: #%d" % bug_num)
+            continue
+        if bug.duplicate_of is not None:
+            bug = bug.duplicate_of
+            print("LP: #%d is a duplicate of LP: #%d" % (bug_num, bug.id))
+
+        closed = False
+        commented = False
+        for task in bug.bug_tasks:
+            if task.target_link in target_links:
+                if task.status != "Fix Released":
+                    task.status = "Fix Released"
+                    task.lp_save()
+                    print("Closed LP: #%d (%s)" % (bug.id, task.web_link))
+                else:
+                    print("LP: #%d (%s) already closed" %
+                          (bug.id, task.web_link))
+                if not commented:
+                    bug.newMessage(content=message)
+                    commented = True
+                closed = True
+        if not closed:
+            print("Cannot find any tasks on LP: #%d to close." % bug.id)
+
